# AI Primitives

> A dependency-free library of monochrome UI primitives for AI-native interfaces — loading states, thinking traces, streaming text, approval cards, tool chips, and more. Motion is drawn with the plain HTML5 Canvas 2D API: no WebGL, no SVG filters, no blur.

## Primitives — 18 ready

- Loading State — 8 orbs: CloningOrb, SyncOrb, FetchingOrb, PullingOrb, PushingOrb, MergingOrb, RebasingOrb, StashingOrb — Canvas 2D, monochrome, `size` `orbSizes xs 16 → 2xl 96`, `speed`, `paused`, `aria-label`
- Thinking — 2: CubeOrb (Thinking), ScanOrb (Scan)
- Streaming & Cards — 8: StreamingText, ApprovalCard, ToolChips, TaskRows, Chat, RecommendationCard, ContextCards, DiffTable

SyncOrb: square 8×8 flat → diagonal shimmer → supernova suck → globe with 3-ring flash (each plane), clipped flash inside sphere, perfect loop 3.6s.

## Install

npm install @ai-primitives/orbs
pnpm add @ai-primitives/orbs

import { CloningOrb, SyncOrb } from "@ai-primitives/orbs";
<CloningOrb size={64} aria-label="Cloning" />
<SyncOrb size={64} aria-label="Sync" />

## Theming

- system via matchMedia + inline THEME_INIT_SCRIPT before hydration (no FOUC)
- --orb-fg on any ancestor, or color prop per instance (alpha via ink())
